summary: Solaris Energy Infrastructure filed an 8-K disclosing a September 1, 2026 merger agreement to acquire Omega Foundation Services LLC via two-step merger with Omega Holdco, funded by 3,599,199 Class A shares and roughly $77 million cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments for cash, debt and net working capital. The seller, Andrew W. Bennett, receives equity plus cash and accepts 180-day lockup, non-compete and indemnity covenants. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the acquisition closed same date. Watch integration risk, share overhang post-lockup, and Omega's Louisiana oilfield services exposure.
